lessons: When a subprocess/test hangs with no output, `pytest -o faulthandler_timeout=N` dumps every thread's stack; it found the TestClient-vs-infinite-stream hang in one run.
Don't hand-roll binary fixtures (my first fake JPEG was hex guesswork); generate one with the real encoder once, verify it decodes, embed the bytes.
A 'wait for any frame' sequence check needs the initial counter chosen so the first wait actually blocks; the off-by-one made snapshot() return None immediately.
pkill from inside a Bash tool call kills the shell's own group (exit 144); background the server in a subshell and kill by PID instead.
